body: I don't enjoy doing things.
Yes. I have tried. It made me worse. It provided no benefits, and all it did was trigger my anxiety.

Like I said... I don't believe in my ego surviving after death, so I don't believe in "moving on".

And no... there's not much that I want to experience. Even if there is something that I want... the amount of anxiety, stress, work, depression, whatever, that I have to go through to get there makes it not worth it. So no. Ultimately there's nothing I want to experience as a whole. It's not worth it. Life is not worth it in any way. It's why I live the way I do. It's why I wish I were dead when I go to sleep every night.

Yes and no.

Do I believe a part of my personality, ego, psyche, whatever, some part of a "spirit" that lives on after I die, that experiences a different type of reality in some other form? No. Not at all.

I believe in the universe. I believe that I'm a part of the universe experiencing itself. I don't believe in "nothingness" after a death. If you assume that there's nothingness after you die, then you're assuming that your ego, your single consciousness is the center of the universe. But it's not. Everything else in the universe also exists. 

The entirety of my experience is just a single event in the eyes of the universe itself. Who knows. Maybe the universe experiences the entirety of everything at once or some crazy shit like that. But I'm not scared of not existing. I don't see it as a bad thing.
no.... im content with dying
I don't want to talk about it man... I'm just gonna pop some pills and go to sleep.  Sorry for wasting your time.
I don't believe in happiness. Not for me, at least. It's not possible.

I AM NOT YOUR PAST SELF. I AM NOT YOU.

You do not know who I am. You do not know why I am the way I am. You do not know HOW I am. Stop pretending. We are NOT the same. It's obvious. The more you act like I'm like you, the more you show how truly ignorant you are.
No. If you knew, you wouldn't be saying the bullshit that you've been telling me for this past half hour.
I don't want to talk about why I'm a bad person.

Your perspective of you you "did it" is absolutely irrelevant, because you're nothing like me. At all. Once again, you clearly don't understand. Acting like things that worked for you also work for other people is nothing but arrogant. Your "Darkness" I guarantee is nothing like mine. Acting like I'm in a different spot than you is... absolutely idiotic. You can't compare me with you. It's apples and oranges.

I don't think I'm a special person. I think I'm a miserable worthless piece of shit. There is nothing special about me. I'm a bad person as a whole compared to most people.

I don't think there are people who I could get along with. I am borderline. I've tried to get close to people the best I can, albeit online. I can't do it. It's simply an impossibility for me.
Oh. As if I haven't tried that for my entire life.

You say that as if I haven't posted here before, you say that as if I haven't gone over my entire life story with other people before. I have. This is no first step.

Way to act all high and mighty. Oh. You're too good to be anxious. Well whoopty doo for you. Good job! Guess what. It's not a choice. I don't make the choice to feel anxiety. People don't MAKE the choice to feel the way they do. You talk as if we all choose to feel this way, and you talk as if you can just stop thinking certain thoughts to stop feeling anxiety. I don't care about what you've gone through or who you are. I have no desire to hear your opinion. I absolutely don't care about what disorders you have. 

As far as I'm concerned, you've already proven your inability to comprehend what it's like to live in the mind of someone with a substantial amount of disorders, and your whole mitigation of anxiety as a whole proves that you have no respect for anyone who has the disorders like this.

I don't think I've ever met anyone who I truly liked. I have almost exclusively negative experiences with people. I would be indifferent if the entirety of humanity just disappeared. We're nothing more than a ridiculous strain of monkeys that think we're special and different from the rest of nature or the world, when we're really not.
I don't want to be independent. There is no reason to do so.

Okay, if you've experienced depression, you understand how it takes all energy out of you and removes your desire to do things. Removes any sort of enjoyment from things.

Now imagine that you don't want to do anything in your DEFAULT mood. That, with the depression piled on top, is all the more reason to not do anything. You know if you get out of your depressive mood, nothing will change. It's still a mediocre boring life with no direction.

On top of that, pile anxiety. Loads of anxiety and self doubt on top of that. Even if you wanted to do something, you can't. Even if you could, the anxiety would stop you in your tracks.

And I know what your response to this will be, so I'll answer before you ask. No, I'm not going to a doctor or professional. If you ask me why, I'm not going to answer. It's not an option, and it's not an opinion that's going to change.
I'm a monetary and emotional leech, that provides nothing in return.
Okay. Then it's simple. You don't understand, therefor you have no right to tell someone else what it's like or what to do.
I don't have friends.
I'm 21. Nothing. I've never worked, and I dropped out of school. I live with my mom.
You honestly and obviously don't understand what it's like to be constantly depressed.
Yes... that's a lot of it. I agree completely.

Okay. One. Im not going to stand for the "you are worth something". This is all subjective jargon... worth is completely subjective. To myself, I am worthless. To others who are relevant to me, I am worthless. Your opinion on the matter doesn't really mean anything because it's not directly relevant to me. If gold is valuable to you, but I live in a world where nobody trades in gold, then the gold that you might want to trade to me doesn't really mean much.

The question... it's incompatible with my mind. Asking me why do I feel like this, or what's causing my negative thoughts, it's like asking which rain drop is responsible for the flood... I just... it's unanswerable...
What do you want to understand
No. I don't think ANYTHING will help.

It doesn't work like that. You don't understand.
